quests.title: Pastor Tau - Swamp Stickers
quests.prereqText: Level 150+, have completed Rosaline Gracia - Childhood Promise
steps: Talk to Pastor Tau at Swamp Town - Carbigal.

Get 13x Swamp Sticker: Black Swamp sticker quests: Bard La Fimmel, Clerk Z. Smith, Cluck Cluck Warrior, Farmer Tsetsech, Favian, Frog Prince, Frog Shaman - Swamp Magic 4, Genius Cochma - Black Swamp Survey 4, Kristoffer J., Lethos - Black Swamp Treasure 4, Madam Sarah, Monkey T - Monkey T Business 4, Pastor Tau - Tau's Request 2, Poppuri, Princess Rosetta, Swampy Suu, Vagabond Eloy, Vinosh.
Get 1x Adventurer's Book: reward from Rosaline Gracia - Childhood Promise.
Bring everything back to Pastor Tau.

source.from: Black Swamp sticker quests: Bard La Fimmel, Clerk Z. Smith, Cluck Cluck Warrior, Farmer Tsetsech, Favian, Frog Prince, Frog Shaman - Swamp Magic 4, Genius Cochma - Black Swamp Survey 4, Kristoffer J., Lethos - Black Swamp Treasure 4, Madam Sarah, Monkey T - Monkey T Business 4, Pastor Tau - Tau's Request 2, Poppuri, Princess Rosetta, Swampy Suu, Vagabond Eloy, Vinosh
Reward from Rosaline Gracia - Childhood Promise

quests.notes: Swamp Sticker comes from that area's sticker quests (see the source on the item). Adventurer's Book is obtained by completing Rosaline Gracia - Childhood Promise.

quests.title: Madam Sarah - Sarah's Flashback
quests.prereqText: Level 150+, have completed Pastor Tau - Swamp Stickers
steps: Talk to Madam Sarah at Carbigal Tea House.
Get 1x Lotus Flower: dropped by Lotus Wormhole (Lv.219) in Swamp Dungeon 4 - Marshy Garden / 5 - Marshy Lawn.
Get 5x Lotus Leaf: dropped by Chameleon Frog (Lv.169) in Swamp Field 2 - Beaver's Swamp / 4 - Dark Omen.
Bring everything back to Madam Sarah.

source.map: Swamp Dungeon 4 - Marshy Garden / 5 - Marshy Lawn
Swamp Field 2 - Beaver's Swamp / 4 - Dark Omen

quests.notes: Lotus Flower is dropped by Lotus Wormhole (Lv.219). Lotus Leaf is dropped by Chameleon Frog (Lv.169).
